summary: United States Oil Fund, LP disclosed in an Item 1.01 8-K that The Marygold Companies, Inc. (TMC), its parent through USCF Investments, agreed to be taken private by Madison Dearborn Partners in an all-cash transaction. TMC is sole shareholder of USCF Investments, the sole member of the fund's general partner. Expected close in the first half of 2027, subject to TMC stockholder approval, regulatory and change-of-control consents. TMC shares will delist from NYSE. MDP and TMC plan to refocus USCF's business post-close. Watch consent timing and risk of non-completion.
